pages.title: It Comes Together
pages.text: Equip one passive and trigger its actual benefit: Technician, Stamina Pillager or Death Harvest.

pages.title: It Comes Together
pages.text: Pair a passive with the action that actually returns its combat resource.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Technician rewards a timed dodge, Stamina Pillager a kill and Death Harvest an innate-skill kill. Choose an available route; collecting all three is unnecessary.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Passives respond to their own events, not mere equipment: dodge, kill or innate-skill kill.
